name: tmux
readme_excerpt: Welcome to tmux! tmux is a terminal multiplexer: it enables a number of terminals to be created, accessed, and controlled from a single screen. tmux may be detached from a screen and continue running in the background, then later reattached. This release runs on OpenBSD, FreeBSD, NetBSD, Linux, macOS and Solaris. Dependencies tmux depends on libevent 2.x, available from this page. It also depends on ncurses, available from this page.
